title: File:Namtok Mae Surin, Waterfall, Thailand.jpg
author: Vyacheslav Argenberg
description: Mae Surin Waterfall. Numerous streams and rivers around. A mix of evergreen and deciduous hill forest with some Dipterocarp trees. It was the last place in northern Thailand where you could spot an Indochinese leopard in the wild. Namtok Mae Surin, Doi Pui Area, Mae Hong Son Province, Thanon Thong Chai Range, Thailand.
